messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up for partner teams — we're proposing a breaking change to the API response envelope that will affect SDKs and marketplace connectors. Per-request metadata (trace_id, region, model_variant) will be moved into a single 'meta' object instead of living at the top-level. This means naive parsers will break. Target canary: 2026-05-12, full rollout: 2026-06-02. Posting migration guide and RFC today. @Ravi @Marta @Leo :eyes:

Ravi: Thanks. Do we also plan to add a response version header so older clients can detect incompatibility? That would make client-side fallback cleaner.

Marta: yes — plan is to add X-Redwood-Resp-Version: 2 in the canary. SDKs should check that header and fall back or raise a descriptive error. I'll sketch the client change this morning.

Leo: From partnership/marketplace side — need to map which listings have custom parsers (webhooks, SI adapters). I'll do a sweep and ping vendors that parse top-level fields. Can we offer a 6-week grace window for marketplace integrations to update?

Ava: Grace window is negotiable but we should lock the canary date. Ops needs time for feature-flagged rollout. 6 weeks post-canary for partner updates sounds reasonable.

Jordan: On the infra side I'll gate the canary behind the feature flag + rollout policy: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% across 3 days. Also adding an automated compatibility check that runs a set of partner-like requests and validates older parsing behavior. Need the test vectors from Partnerships.

Marta: Quick minimal code snippet for partners to detect new envelope (Python):
```python
# old: resp.get('trace_id')
# new: resp['meta']['trace_id'] if resp.get('meta') else resp.get('trace_id')
version = resp.headers.get('X-Redwood-Resp-Version')
if version == '2' or resp.get('meta'):
    trace = resp['meta'].get('trace_id')
else:
    trace = resp.get('trace_id')
```
This will be in the migration doc with examples for JS, Go, Java.

Ravi: For partners on older runtimes (embedded appliances), is there a recommended shim they can ship? Maybe a small proxy that rewrites responses back to v1 shape?

Marta: Yep — we can provide a lightweight proxy example in node (express) that fetches, rewrites meta to top-level, and forwards. Will include Dockerfile for vendors that can't update in place.

Leo: I'm assembling partner comms templates: email + marketplace banner + release notes. Also coordinating with legal for any SLA language where connectors degrade.

Ava: Action items:
- Marta: publish migration guide + shims by EOD Friday (1742590000 slack followup)
- Leo: partner sweep + comm templates by next Tue
- Ravi: list of critical partners that need private handholding (drop ping here)
- Jordan: add compatibility test vectors and gate into canary job
- Ops: feature flag + X-Redwood-Resp-Version enforcement for canary

CI Bot: Deploy job scheduled: canary-feature-flag -> runs nightly, first run 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC.

Ava: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC and a short partner note in #partnerships-docs. Please add any vendor names you want prioritized in this thread. :thumbsup:
